newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank bond rate drops to 2.617 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank bond rate drops to 2.617 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.617 percent a month, from 2.638 percent last week, at today's 7.249 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations and did not indicate any change in the current level of the interest rates in the money market, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on October 23. Today's auction is expected to add 251 million reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
